products.name: Proof Approval Queue
products.product: A focused print and sign proof approval tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent sign shops, commercial printers, and display fabricators
products.problem: Proof PDFs, marked-up screenshots, revised artwork, colors, dimensions, copy, and customer approvals move through email without one production-authorized version.
products.valueProposition: Turns print and sign proof approval tracking into a visible operating queue so every job enters production only from an exact proof version approved by the authorized customer contact.
products.topic: print and sign proof approval tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets print proof approval, sign proofing software, customer artwork approval, and print shop proof tracker searches.

products.name: Install Readiness Board
products.product: A focused sign installation readiness tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent sign shops, commercial printers, and display fabricators
products.problem: Fabrication completion does not guarantee install readiness when permits, site access, survey dimensions, hardware, equipment, crew, weather, and customer windows remain open.
products.valueProposition: Turns sign installation readiness tracking into a visible operating queue so every installation dispatch has verified product, site, permission, equipment, crew, and customer readiness.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets sign installation checklist, sign shop install scheduling, sign job readiness, and sign installation workflow searches.
